g.title: crate Typed editing state and text layout contracts.
crate::behavior Editor behavior hooks: the routed request, its context and the outcome.
crate::change Recorded range replacements of a text and the damage they leave.
crate::edit_state `EditState`: a text, its revision and session, changed by recorded edits.
crate::editor Native editor ownership: the document, its edits and the states given back.
crate::geometry The one implementation of caret, hit and range geometry over shaped text.
crate::journal One recorded edit of an editor's document, finished or taken back as a whole.
crate::line_colors Per-line coloring hooks and the state carried from one line to the next.
crate::session An edit session: selection anchor, caret and IME composition, holding no text.
crate::text_layout Snapshots of an editor's shaped lines and carets.
